flags.fix: Bà chúa sai người hầu mang trà lên. = The lord's wife ordered a servant to bring tea.

flags.why: The entry omits the common use referring to a paternal aunt, which can carry a dismissive tone ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%A0_c%C3%B4)).
This sense insults a woman as difficult or spiteful and needs a derogatory warning ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%A0_c%C3%B4)).
